$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：太陽天梁坐卯酉，《深造講義》p.61。

basis.quote: 须分别其为祥和抑为孤忌

rules.text: 孤的一面較重，最適合帶點獨立性質的工作，例如醫藥、保險、機械工程、法律。
rules.en: With the solitary side stronger, work with an independent edge suits you best, such as medicine, insurance, mechanical engineering or law.

source.quote: 最宜从事带点孤习性质的工作

rules.text: 你的太陽天梁在卯，三方四正不見煞忌，是極祥和的組合。
rules.en: Your Tai Yang–Tian Liang sits in Mao with no malefics or Ji in its four directions: a very peaceful combination.

source.quote: 则为极祥和的星系组合

rules.text: 你的太陽化忌，坐在日落的酉宮，又見煞星：這組星孤剋的色彩最重。
rules.en: Your Tai Yang is transformed by Ji, sits in the setting-sun palace of You, and meets malefics: these stars at their most solitary.

source.quote: 便呈现极其孤忌的色彩

rules.text: 會照的天同化忌，令你和六親的關係較疏離。
rules.en: Tian Tong transformed by Ji in your four directions makes ties with family more distant.

rules.text: 會照的巨門化忌，令你一生較易受是非、糾紛困擾。
rules.en: Ju Men transformed by Ji in your four directions leaves you more exposed to gossip and disputes through life.

source.quote: 一生易受是非、纠纷困扰
